t: The Logistics of Thought: From S-Curves to the Command Line
s: This article explores maintaining intellectual clarity and technical sovereignty in AI development, advocating for the command line's role in automation and vendor lock-in avoidance, while using conceptual tools like the logistics S-curve for clear thinking.
sub: Investigating Google's Gemini CLI for scriptable AI assistance in software development.
Utilizing the logistics S-curve as a mental model for understanding growth, limits, and clarity in complex systems.
Advocating for the command-line interface (CLI) as a tool for automation, future-proofing, and avoiding vendor lock-in in software development.
Analyzing the challenges of signal-to-noise ratio in the age of AI-generated content and its impact on clear thought.
